title: Manns Search For Meenie 31
author: bpatrick
body: johhnydollar called it. I had been planning this reference for years now. Uncanny.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text:
johnnydollar is not Jonny Paycheck. This prompted a re-visitation of the old MSFM and comments so I actually know what’s going on.

Almost five years early, that johnnydollar is some kind of psychic.

comments.author: AJ
comments.text: i imagine that tattoo will be some kind of Chekovs gun

comments.author: Sir Exal
comments.text:
Well, that escalated from a cool concept to awesomeness fairly quickly.

Is the idea of the feng shui assassin borrowed from Chuck Palahniuk’s Haunted? I seem to remember a line (from Mother Nature’s Story, “Foot Work”) something like “They tell you never to arrange a room with two ottomans against the east wall, but they never tell you why.

comments.author: WolffBrosef2
comments.text: I cracked up at the Satanic Circus part. Classic. I hope to see more of this soon; it’s one of my favorites of all your stories.

comments.author: marlon fontanez
comments.text: WHAT! THE HELL MAN YOU GET ME HOOKED THEN YOU CUT ME OFF FINISH THIS MOTHER FUCKER FINISH IT!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

comments.author: FractalFreak
comments.text: i have read everything you have done and may i say i am damn impressed this and bob and bob are my favourites but the wealth of ideas are absolutely incredible, found you through subnormality and i cannot decide who is superior, perhaps once you come close to the amount winston has put out into the world it will be easier to make a comparison. BUT anyways genuinely incredible work man.

comments.author: Ian
comments.text: I’m with FractalFreak, except in trying to compare your work and Winston Rowntree’s. You’re both fantastic artists and storytellers and I now need both of you to keep writing so I never run out of comix for too long. Thank you very much.
